changes: Display listener tracks 180-degree changes as well as portrait/landscape changes
Preview, ImageAnalysis and ImageCapture explicitly share target display rotation
Viewport size/rotation changes rebuild the same UseCaseGroup and clear old capture/corner/focus state
Landscape controls move to a side column; profile and timer remain available through camera settings
Long profile/title text is bounded; portrait timer control no longer wraps into the viewfinder

actualCameraFlow.source: Own synthetic paper with four different corner colors, fed through emulator imagefile camera
actualCameraFlow.environment: API35 AOSP x86_64 emulator; actual CameraX analysis/preview/JPEG save callbacks
actualCameraFlow.referenceDecision: All four saved captures had stale analysis references; actual photo redetection was used, not claimed as fresh-candidate reuse
actualCameraFlow.landscapeViewfinder: Side controls replace the previous narrow strip caused by top and bottom controls

focusedCheck.scope: One concentrated check using the four actual saved camera JPEGs; no old suites rerun
focusedCheck.expectedBounds: Independently extracted from connected white paper pixels with Pillow/OpenCV, separate from app detection
focusedCheck.independentVerification: Pillow counted the same four retained color regions in actual app-rendered PNGs

limits: This verifies camera pipeline geometry and EXIF handling on an emulator, not physical lens correction or handheld capture quality
Static synthetic camera input does not establish finger occlusion, real motion, glare or ARM timing quality
CORE03/CORE04 physical movement and rearm acceptance remain separately open
